UTF-8 renderer manual fixture

Manual test notes:
- Open this file in THE in a UTF-8 terminal.
- Use the cursor keys across every A<sample>B pattern.
- A single user-visible grapheme cluster should be one editor stop, even when it occupies two or more terminal cells.
- Moving left/right should never enter the middle of a combining sequence, flag, skin-tone emoji, keycap, or ZWJ emoji.
- Moving up/down or clicking inside a wide/complex cluster should snap to the start of that cluster.
- The software cursor should cover the whole cluster in overwrite mode and the configured insert cursor in insert mode.
- The status field should show the expanded cluster plus decomposed U+ code points, truncated with ... when too long.
- In the status field, invisible presentation selectors use markers: FE0E -> T and FE0F -> E, except inside ZWJ previews; keycaps use a base plus safe outline marker.
- Use VERIFY or horizontal scrolling on the clipping lines so the first visible screen cell lands before, on, and inside wide clusters.
- Do not intentionally include invalid UTF-8 here; byte-invalid cases belong in automated textpos tests.

macOS Terminal regression focus:
- Cursor left/right over these lines should leave no stale software-cursor image.
- Cursor left from B should stop on the preceding cluster, not inside or after it.
- Cursor right from the cluster should stop on B, not skip B or remain stuck.
mac-keycap-tight: A1️⃣B#️⃣C*️⃣D
mac-flag-tight: A🇺🇸B🇨🇦C🇬🇧D
mac-2face-tight: A👩‍❤️‍👨B👨‍❤️‍👨C👩‍❤️‍👩D
